Visible text:
Hydraulic power: symbol key

P = ρ g H Q

ρ = fluid density

g = gravitational acceleration

H = head (vertical height difference)

Q = volume flow rate

Visual structure:
A plain white slide with a large dark gray title at the upper left. Below it, the equation “P = ρ g H Q” appears on its own line. Four definitions are arranged vertically beneath the equation, aligned to the left: rho, g, H, and Q. There are no diagrams, arrows, tables, or other graphic elements.
